name: Polymarket BTC window strike delta
description: Distance of the internally hosted BTC spot reference from the bound Polymarket market strike. reference_price and strike are the ready spot reference and the rules-card strike; delta_absolute is reference minus strike (signed); delta_bps is delta_absolute divided by strike times ten thousand. The spot reference is computed inside this process by the identical published btc.external.spot_reference@1.0.0 code path over the Coinbase and Kraken ticker streams, so it is pinned here as a signal-kind input. A ready update requires a bound market with a validated rules card and a ready spot reference; otherwise the update is non-ready with fixed reason codes and omits values rather than substituting stale numbers. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
